method: Intersect object-wide live external fixups with lexical names in the clock routine source range; resolve providers only from objects explicitly listed in the diagnostic link response.
limitations: The OMF inspection reports fixups at object scope; lexical intersection is an upper bound, not per-routine relocation attribution.
Diagnostic chardata and msbio1 are provisional reconstructed providers; no production certification is implied.
The msinit object has additional live initialization dependencies, including initstub, outside this scoped analysis.
